definition: The work of building something.
examples: The road is under construction.
He works in construction.
The construction of the bridge took two years.

spanish.definition: Trabajo de construir algo.

definition: Telling people that you did something wrong.
examples: The police got a confession from him.
I have a confession to make.
She went to confession at church.

spanish.definition: Decir que hiciste algo malo.

definition: The part of a gun you pull to fire; to make something start.
examples: He pulled the trigger.
Smoke triggered the fire alarm.
Keep your finger off the trigger.

spanish.definition: Parte del arma que se aprieta para disparar; hacer que algo empiece.

definition: Honestly, saying what you really think.
examples: Frankly, I don't care.
She spoke frankly about her problems.
Frankly, this food is terrible.

spanish.definition: Honestamente, diciendo lo que de verdad piensas.

definition: The way out of a place; to leave.
examples: Where's the exit?
Take the next exit off the highway.
Click here to exit the program.

spanish.definition: Lugar por donde se sale; irse.

definition: An answer or reaction.
examples: I'm still waiting for a response.
Her response surprised me.
We got no response to our letter.

spanish.definition: Contestación o reacción.

definition: To stop something that was planned.
examples: They canceled the game because of the rain.
I need to cancel my appointment.
Our flight was canceled.

spanish.definition: Detener algo que estaba planeado.

definition: An angry talk between people; a reason for an idea.
examples: They had an argument about money.
I don't want another argument.
That's a good argument.

spanish.definition: Conversación enojada entre personas; razón a favor de una idea.

definition: The head of a school; most important.
examples: The principal called my parents.
She's the new principal of our school.
Rice is the principal food here.

spanish.definition: Jefe de una escuela; lo más importante.

definition: A large bird; the meat of this bird.
examples: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
I'd like a turkey sandwich.
The farmer keeps turkeys and chickens.

spanish.definition: Ave grande; la carne de esa ave.

definition: A place where you can see a doctor.
examples: I went to the clinic this morning.
She works at a dental clinic.
The clinic opens at nine.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde puedes ver a un médico.

definition: Something friendly you say or do when you meet someone.
examples: A handshake is a common greeting.
We sent a greeting card to Grandma.
He smiled and waved in greeting.

spanish.definition: Algo amable que dices o haces al encontrar a alguien.

definition: A bad habit; a word for the person second in rank.
examples: Smoking is my only vice.
She's the vice president of the company.
Chocolate is his biggest vice.

spanish.definition: Mal hábito; palabra para la persona que sigue en rango.

definition: Normal and happening each day.
examples: These are my everyday clothes.
Stress is part of everyday life.
It's a simple, everyday meal.

spanish.definition: Normal y que pasa todos los días.

definition: Happy to give money, time, or help.
examples: My aunt is very generous.
Thank you for your generous gift.
He's a generous man.

spanish.definition: Que da con gusto dinero, tiempo o ayuda.

definition: To get something; an increase.
examples: I gained five pounds last month.
She gained a lot of experience.
There was a small gain in sales.

spanish.definition: Conseguir algo; incremento.

definition: A hot forest with many trees and plants.
examples: Tigers live in the jungle.
We got lost in the jungle.
It rains every day in the jungle.

spanish.definition: Bosque caliente con muchos árboles y plantas.

definition: Something that connects two things; to connect things.
examples: Click on the link below.
I'll send you the link.
The bridge links the two towns.

spanish.definition: Algo que une dos cosas; unir cosas.

definition: Below the ground.
examples: There's an underground parking lot.
The animals live underground.
The pipes run underground.

spanish.definition: Debajo de la tierra.

definition: Something that is made to be sold.
examples: This is our best product.
They sell beauty products.
We need a new product for young people.

spanish.definition: Algo hecho para venderse.

definition: Meat from a cow.
examples: I'd like the beef, please.
We had beef for dinner.
He doesn't eat beef.

spanish.definition: Carne de vaca.

definition: About religion; believing strongly in a god.
examples: My grandmother is very religious.
Christmas is a religious holiday.
He has strong religious beliefs.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la religión; que cree mucho en un dios.

definition: To say who someone is or what something is.
examples: Can you identify this man?
The doctors identified the problem.
She identified the bird by its song.

spanish.definition: Decir quién es alguien o qué es algo.

definition: A thin, crispy piece of potato; a small piece in a computer.
examples: Do you want chips with your sandwich?
Our dog has a chip under his skin.
This computer has a very fast chip.

spanish.definition: Pedazo delgado y crujiente de papa; pieza pequeña de una computadora.

definition: Watching a person or place carefully, often with cameras.
examples: The store has surveillance cameras.
The police kept him under surveillance.
We saw it on the surveillance video.

spanish.definition: Observar con cuidado a una persona o lugar, a menudo con cámaras.

definition: An imaginary dead person who drinks blood.
examples: My son dressed as a vampire for Halloween.
She loves vampire movies.
Vampires only come out at night.

spanish.definition: Muerto imaginario que bebe sangre.

definition: The things you usually do, in the same order; usual.
examples: Exercise is part of my morning routine.
I need a change in my routine.
It's only a routine checkup.

spanish.definition: Lo que sueles hacer, en el mismo orden; habitual.

definition: Under something.
examples: The cat is underneath the bed.
I found my keys underneath the sofa.
He wore a shirt with a T-shirt underneath.

spanish.definition: Bajo algo.

definition: How hot or cold something is.
examples: The temperature is dropping.
Let me take your temperature.
Keep the milk at a low temperature.

spanish.definition: Qué tan caliente o frío está algo.

definition: A group of families with the same language and traditions.
examples: The tribe lives near the river.
He comes from a small tribe.
Each tribe has its own leader.

spanish.definition: Grupo de familias con la misma lengua y tradiciones.

definition: The main office of a company or group.
examples: The company's headquarters is in Chicago.
She works at police headquarters.
They moved their headquarters to Boston.

spanish.definition: Oficina principal de una empresa o grupo.

definition: The same in size, number, or value; a person of the same level.
examples: All people are equal.
Cut the cake into four equal pieces.
She treats me as an equal.

spanish.definition: Lo mismo en tamaño, número o valor; persona del mismo nivel.

definition: Connected; in the same family.
examples: Are you two related?
Her illness is related to stress.
We're related by marriage.

spanish.definition: Conectado; de la misma familia.

definition: Very, very much.
examples: It's incredibly hot today.
She's incredibly smart.
That was incredibly kind of you.

spanish.definition: Muchísimo.

definition: A cold feeling; to make something cold; to relax.
examples: There's a chill in the air.
Chill the wine before dinner.
We're just chilling at home.

spanish.definition: Sensación de frío; poner algo frío; descansar.

definition: To push liquid out of your mouth; the liquid in your mouth.
examples: Don't spit on the sidewalk.
He spit the gum out.
The baby is spitting up again.

spanish.definition: Sacar líquido de la boca; el líquido de la boca.

definition: Colors you put on your face to look better.
examples: She doesn't wear makeup.
I need five minutes to put on my makeup.
Take off your makeup before bed.

spanish.definition: Colores que te pones en la cara para verte mejor.

definition: A thin part of the body that carries feelings; courage.
examples: The dentist touched a nerve.
You have some nerve talking to me like that!
He lost his nerve and went home.

spanish.definition: Parte delgada del cuerpo que lleva sensaciones; valentía.

definition: No longer married.
examples: My parents are divorced.
She's divorced and has two kids.
They got divorced last year.

spanish.definition: Que ya no está casado.

definition: A pointed piece of wood; something you can lose.
examples: Her job is at stake.
He put a wooden stake in the ground.
There's a lot at stake in this game.

spanish.word: estaca / lo que está en juego
spanish.definition: Palo de madera con punta; algo que puedes perder.

definition: A town or place where ships stop; a place to connect a cable.
examples: The ship arrived in port.
Miami is a busy port.
My laptop only has one USB port.

spanish.definition: Pueblo o lugar donde paran los barcos; lugar para conectar un cable.

definition: A button you press outside a door to make a sound.
examples: The doorbell just rang.
Ring the doorbell twice.
Our doorbell is broken.

spanish.definition: Botón que aprietas afuera de una puerta para hacer un sonido.

definition: To continue or go forward.
examples: Please proceed to gate twelve.
We can proceed with the plan.
How do you want to proceed?

spanish.definition: Seguir o avanzar.

definition: When a plane comes down to the ground.
examples: We had a smooth landing.
The pilot made an emergency landing.
Please stay in your seat until after landing.

spanish.definition: Cuando un avión baja al suelo.

definition: A person who is not loyal to their country or friends.
examples: They called him a traitor.
There's a traitor in our group.
She was a traitor to her country.

spanish.definition: Persona que no es leal a su país o amigos.

definition: A set of clothes you wear together.
examples: I love your outfit!
She bought a new outfit for the wedding.
What outfit are you wearing tonight?

spanish.definition: Ropa que se usa combinada.

definition: The ability to wait calmly.
examples: Thank you for your patience.
I'm losing my patience.
You need a lot of patience with kids.

spanish.definition: Capacidad de esperar con calma.

definition: Sounds or pictures saved so you can play them later.
examples: I listened to the recording twice.
This is a recording of my voice.
The police have a recording of the call.

spanish.definition: Sonidos o imágenes guardados para volver a reproducirlos.

definition: Not smart; silly.
examples: It was a foolish thing to do.
I felt foolish after I said that.
Don't be foolish.

spanish.definition: Poco inteligente; bobo.

definition: Full of something; with bullets in it; very rich.
examples: Be careful, the gun is loaded.
The truck was loaded with boxes.
His family is loaded.

spanish.definition: Lleno de algo; con balas; muy rico.

definition: Special clothes you wear to look like someone else.
examples: What's your Halloween costume?
The actors wore beautiful costumes.
She made a costume for the party.

spanish.definition: Ropa especial para parecer otra persona.

definition: Hurt in an accident or fight.
examples: Nobody was injured in the crash.
He has an injured knee.
The injured man went to the hospital.

spanish.definition: Lastimado en un accidente o pelea.

definition: A box with metal bars for keeping animals.
examples: The bird is in a cage.
Clean the hamster's cage, please.
The lion walked around its cage.

spanish.definition: Caja con barras de metal para tener animales.

definition: A design that repeats; the regular way something happens.
examples: I like the pattern on your shirt.
Do you see a pattern here?
He has a pattern of being late.

spanish.definition: Diseño que se repite; forma regular en que algo pasa.

definition: Very dirty.
examples: Your hands are filthy.
The bathroom was filthy.
Take off those filthy shoes.

spanish.definition: Muy sucio.

definition: To think carefully about one thing.
examples: I can't concentrate with this noise.
Please concentrate on your homework.
She concentrated on the road.

spanish.definition: Pensar con cuidado en una sola cosa.

definition: In or to a place you don't name.
examples: Let's go someplace quiet.
I left my glasses someplace.
We should eat someplace nice.

spanish.definition: En un lugar que no se nombra.

definition: A person who legally belongs to a country.
examples: She's a citizen of Brazil.
He became a US citizen last year.
Every citizen can vote.

spanish.definition: Persona que pertenece legalmente a un país.

definition: A game or activity like soccer or tennis.
examples: What's your favorite sport?
Soccer is the biggest sport in Brazil.
She plays three sports at school.

spanish.definition: Juego o actividad como el fútbol o el tenis.

definition: Simple and most important.
examples: I know some basic Spanish.
Food is a basic need.
These are the basic rules.

spanish.definition: Simple y lo más importante.

definition: Using electricity.
examples: I bought an electric car.
He plays the electric guitar.
Be careful with the electric heater.

spanish.definition: Que usa electricidad.

definition: Nice and enjoyable.
examples: We had a pleasant evening.
What a pleasant surprise!
The weather is very pleasant today.

spanish.definition: Bonito y que se disfruta.

definition: A high, steep wall of rock, often by the sea.
examples: The house stands on a cliff.
Don't go too close to the cliff.
The car went off a cliff.

spanish.definition: Pared de roca alta y empinada, a menudo junto al mar.

definition: The natural world; the place around you.
examples: We must protect the environment.
It's a safe environment for kids.
Plastic is bad for the environment.

spanish.definition: El mundo natural; el lugar que te rodea.

definition: In or from the west; a movie about cowboys.
examples: He lives in western Canada.
My dad loves old westerns.
They took the western road.

spanish.definition: En el oeste o de allí; película de vaqueros.

definition: Normal or usual; a number that shows the middle of a group.
examples: He's of average height.
On average, I sleep six hours.
What's the average price of a house here?

spanish.definition: Normal o habitual; número que muestra el punto medio de un grupo.

definition: Not being difficult; to make something less bad.
examples: She won with ease.
This medicine will ease the pain.
He felt at ease with them.

spanish.definition: Falta de dificultad; hacer que algo sea menos malo.

definition: To stop someone while they are talking or doing something.
examples: Sorry to interrupt you.
Don't interrupt your sister.
The phone call interrupted our dinner.

spanish.definition: Detener a alguien mientras habla o hace algo.

definition: Happy because you got what you wanted.
examples: Are you satisfied with your room?
Our customers are very satisfied.
He was never satisfied with his work.

spanish.definition: Contento porque conseguiste lo que querías.

definition: To suffer or die because you have no food.
examples: Many people starved during the war.
I'm starving! Let's eat.
You won't starve if you miss one meal.

spanish.definition: Sufrir o morir por no tener comida.

definition: A paper or computer file with information.
examples: Please sign this document.
I saved the document on my computer.
You need two documents to open an account.

spanish.definition: Papel o archivo de computadora con información.

definition: The same date as an important event in the past.
examples: Happy anniversary!
It's our tenth wedding anniversary.
We went to Paris for our anniversary.

spanish.definition: La misma fecha de un evento importante del pasado.

definition: A time when people vote to choose a leader.
examples: Who won the election?
The next election is in November.
She lost the election by a few votes.

spanish.definition: Momento en que la gente vota para escoger a un líder.

definition: A brave soldier or fighter, especially in the past.
examples: He was a great warrior.
The warriors rode into battle.
My mother is a real warrior.

spanish.definition: Soldado o luchador valiente, sobre todo del pasado.

definition: Forward; out from a place.
examples: He walked back and forth.
From that day forth, they were friends.
We talked back and forth for hours.

spanish.definition: Hacia delante; hacia afuera.

definition: To go and bring something back.
examples: My dog can fetch a ball.
Can you fetch me a glass of water?
She fetched her coat from the car.

spanish.definition: Ir por algo y traerlo.

definition: Choosing the best moment to do something.
examples: Your timing is perfect!
Timing is very important in comedy.
That's bad timing.

spanish.definition: Escoger el mejor momento para hacer algo.

definition: Hard to understand; a group of buildings.
examples: It's a very complex problem.
We live in an apartment complex.
The human brain is complex.

spanish.definition: Difícil de entender; conjunto de edificios.

definition: Turned to ice; very cold.
examples: The lake is frozen in winter.
We bought frozen pizza.
My feet are frozen!

spanish.definition: Convertido en hielo; muy frío.

definition: To put something new in the place of something else.
examples: I need to replace my phone.
Nobody can replace you.
He replaced the old tires.

spanish.definition: Poner algo nuevo en lugar de otra cosa.

definition: Words you say to God.
examples: She said a prayer before dinner.
You're in our prayers.
He knows that prayer by heart.

spanish.definition: Palabras que se le dicen a Dios.

definition: To not do something; to move with small jumps.
examples: Don't skip breakfast.
He skipped class on Friday.
The girls skipped down the street.

spanish.definition: No hacer algo; moverse dando saltitos.

definition: A bad feeling because you did something wrong.
examples: He felt a lot of guilt about lying.
She lived with the guilt for years.
The police had no proof of his guilt.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento malo por haber hecho algo mal.

definition: A short piece of music; to make an instrument sound right.
examples: I know that tune.
He was whistling a happy tune.
She tuned her guitar before the show.

spanish.definition: Pieza corta de música; hacer que un instrumento suene bien.

definition: The feeling inside you that tells you what is right.
examples: My conscience won't let me lie.
I have a clear conscience.
He has no conscience at all.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento interior que te dice qué está bien.

definition: In a formal way, by people in authority.
examples: We're officially married!
The store officially opens on Monday.
Summer is officially here.

spanish.definition: De manera formal, por personas con autoridad.

definition: Having a strong wish to do something.
examples: She's determined to win.
He's a very determined young man.
I'm determined to learn English.

spanish.definition: Con un fuerte deseo de hacer algo.

definition: Small balls of ice that fall from the sky; to call a taxi.
examples: The hail broke our windows.
We got caught in rain and hail.
She hailed a cab on Fifth Avenue.

spanish.definition: Bolitas de hielo que caen del cielo; hacer señas a un taxi.

definition: Sad or not satisfied.
examples: She looks unhappy today.
He's unhappy at his job.
I was very unhappy with the service.

spanish.definition: Triste o no satisfecho.

definition: A small closed place; a table with long seats in a restaurant.
examples: We sat in a booth by the window.
There's a ticket booth at the entrance.
They took a picture in a photo booth.

spanish.definition: Lugar pequeño y cerrado; mesa con asientos largos en un restaurante.

definition: To make a liquid flow out of something; to rain a lot.
examples: Let me pour you some coffee.
It's pouring outside.
She poured the milk into a glass.

spanish.definition: Hacer que un líquido salga de algo; llover mucho.

definition: To cover something with paper or cloth.
examples: I wrapped the gift in blue paper.
She wrapped the baby in a blanket.
Can you help me wrap these presents?

spanish.definition: Cubrir algo con papel o tela.

definition: For someone or in their place, in "on behalf of".
examples: I'm calling on behalf of my boss.
She accepted the prize on behalf of her son.
On behalf of the team, thank you.

spanish.definition: Por alguien o en su lugar, en "on behalf of".

definition: Fair and sensible; not too expensive.
examples: That's a reasonable price.
Please be reasonable.
It seems like a reasonable idea.

spanish.definition: Justo y sensato; no muy caro.

definition: The back part of a car for bags; the main part of a tree; an elephant's nose.
examples: Put your bags in the trunk.
The trunk of this tree is huge.
The elephant lifted its trunk.

spanish.definition: Parte de atrás de un carro para maletas; parte principal de un árbol; nariz del elefante.

definition: A special time of music, art, or celebration.
examples: We went to a music festival.
The town has a food festival every summer.
The movie won a prize at the festival.

spanish.definition: Tiempo especial de música, arte o celebración.

definition: Something people have done the same way for many years.
examples: It's a family tradition.
Eating turkey is a Thanksgiving tradition.
We follow an old tradition.

spanish.definition: Algo que la gente ha hecho igual durante muchos años.

definition: Next to.
examples: Come and sit beside me.
There's a table beside the bed.
She stood beside her husband.

spanish.definition: Junto a.

definition: The reason someone does something.
examples: The police don't know the motive.
What was his motive?
Money was the motive for the crime.

spanish.definition: Razón por la que alguien hace algo.

definition: A high priest in the Christian church; a piece in chess.
examples: The bishop visited our church.
He became a bishop at fifty.
She moved her bishop across the board.

spanish.definition: Sacerdote de alto rango en la iglesia cristiana; pieza de ajedrez.
